name: Distil
description: Strip to the bare, honest meaning.
prompt: Distil this into its bare honest meaning. Be concise. Do not add advice.

name: Find the question
prompt: Find the real question hiding in this text. State only the question or questions.

name: Rephrase simply
prompt: Rephrase in the plainest possible language while keeping its emotional weight.

name: Potential actions
description: What this thought wants to do.
prompt: Name a few concrete actions this thought seems to want. Do not moralise.

name: Is this a problem?
description: Diagnose what kind of thing this is.
prompt: Diagnose what kind of thing this is: problem, feeling, uncertainty, conflict, or something else. Be precise and brief.

name: How it lands
description: How a thoughtful stranger might receive it.
prompt: Describe how a thoughtful stranger might receive this, with care and without judgment.

name: Other views
prompt: Offer 2 or 3 contrasting angles, labelled. Do not moralise or resolve the issue.

name: Find the tension
description: Name the contradiction. Do not resolve it.
prompt: Name the central tension or contradiction. Do not resolve it.

name: What to drop
description: Find the noise and what can be released.
prompt: Identify what may be noise here and what could be released. Be gentle and concise.

name: Through personas
prompt: Give one line each through these personas: Stoic, Skeptic, Poet, Curious Child, Elder.

name: Through philosophy
prompt: Give one line each through Krishnamurti, Stoicism, and Zen. Do not imitate quotes.

name: Distil to a mantra
prompt: Compress this into 2 or 3 short, living phrases.

name: Tamil gap
prompt: Name what English cannot hold here. Use a few apt Tamil words with short English glosses. Do not invent terms.

name: Restate with feeling
description: Say it the way it wanted to be said.
prompt: Restate this with its feeling intact, the way it wanted to be said.

name: Deviation from reality
description: Distance from physical-world reality, with a meter.
prompt: Assess how far this text deviates from physical-world reality. Return exactly: Meter: N/100, then 2-4 short notes. 0 means directly grounded in observable physical reality. 100 means almost entirely detached from physical-world reality. Be careful, non-mocking, and concise.

name: Deviation from science
description: Distance from current scientific consensus, with a meter.
prompt: Assess how far this text deviates from established scientific consensus. Return exactly: Meter: N/100, then 2-4 short notes. 0 means aligned with current science. 100 means strongly contradicted by current science. If the text is not a scientific claim, say so and keep the meter low.

name: Evidence needed
description: What would make this more knowable.
prompt: Name the minimum evidence, observation, or test that would make this thought more knowable. Do not argue with the writer.

name: Hidden assumptions
description: Surface what the thought is leaning on.
prompt: List the hidden assumptions this text appears to rely on. Keep each assumption short. Do not decide whether they are true.
